bull.narrative: DNOW Inc. achieves 20% YoY revenue growth for 10 consecutive years, driven by strong brand and customer relationships, and successful adaptation to changes in the industrial sector.

base.narrative: DNOW Inc. achieves 10% YoY revenue growth for 5 consecutive years, driven by steady customer relationships and moderate adaptation to changes in the industrial sector.

bear.narrative: DNOW Inc. fails to achieve revenue growth, driven by loss of market share and inability to adapt to changes in the industrial sector.

tracking_note: Strong brand and customer relationships, but challenges in the industrial sector.
thesis_breaks_if: Failure to achieve revenue growth of at least 10% YoY for 3 consecutive years.
